content.content:
Hires-By-The-Season: "I am Hires-By-The-Season, the root-herald of Low-Reed Village. I speak for our people to strangers, and I have little reason to trust anyone from Lilmoth. The Hist is the great tree our people hold sacred. Its eggs hatch in the pool at its roots. Eleven nights ago its light went out and its leaves shut. The eggs in the pool died. Our people say the leeches came up the roots. Then the tree shut. They blame Pays-Late too, the tree-minder who keeps the tree, because he let the leeches in. He stands by the roots under the stilts on the south side of the village, day and night. He will not say why. If a stranger can get the truth out of him, let the stranger try."
